<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_snc_aegis.AEGISResumeScorer</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description> Deterministic scoring engine for resume-to-requisition matching.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AEGISResumeScorer</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var AEGISResumeScorer = Class.create();
AEGISResumeScorer.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    /**
     * Weights: Skills 30%, Experience 25%, Projects 20%, Certifications 15%, Education 10%
     *
     * KNOWN SIMPLIFICATIONS (documented by design for hackathon scope):
     * - If requiredCertsCount=0 is passed, all candidates score 100% on certifications.
     * - If educationMatchLevel='exact' is passed, all candidates score 100% on education.
     * - Projects scoring caps at 5 projects = 100%.
     * To fully implement, add required_certifications and education_level fields to requisition.
     */
    PROJECTS_CAP: 5,

    calculateFitScore: function(matchedSkillsCount, totalRequiredSkills,
                                candidateExpYears, requiredExpYears,
                                relevantProjectsCount, matchingCertsCount,
                                requiredCertsCount, educationMatchLevel) {

        var skills_score = totalRequiredSkills > 0
            ? Math.min((matchedSkillsCount / totalRequiredSkills) * 100, 100) : 0;

        var experience_score;
        if (requiredExpYears <= 0) experience_score = 100;
        else if (candidateExpYears >= requiredExpYears) experience_score = 100;
        else experience_score = (candidateExpYears / requiredExpYears) * 100;

        var projects_score = Math.min((relevantProjectsCount / this.PROJECTS_CAP) * 100, 100);

        var certifications_score;
        if (requiredCertsCount <= 0) certifications_score = 100;
        else certifications_score = Math.min((matchingCertsCount / requiredCertsCount) * 100, 100);

        var education_score;
        switch (educationMatchLevel) {
            case 'exact':     education_score = 100; break;
            case 'one_below': education_score = 70;  break;
            case 'two_below': education_score = 40;  break;
            default:          education_score = 20;
        }

        var fit_score = (skills_score * 0.30) + (experience_score * 0.25) +
                        (projects_score * 0.20) + (certifications_score * 0.15) +
                        (education_score * 0.10);

        return {
            fit_score:             Math.round(fit_score * 100) / 100,
            skills_score:          Math.round(skills_score * 100) / 100,
            experience_score:      Math.round(experience_score * 100) / 100,
            projects_score:        Math.round(projects_score * 100) / 100,
            certifications_score:  Math.round(certifications_score * 100) / 100,
            education_score:       Math.round(education_score * 100) / 100
        };
    },

    generateExplanation: function(scoreResult, matchedSkills, missingSkills) {
        var classification;
        if (scoreResult.fit_score >= 70) classification = 'RECOMMENDED FOR SHORTLISTING';
        else if (scoreResult.fit_score >= 40) classification = 'REQUIRES RECRUITER REVIEW';
        else classification = 'BELOW THRESHOLD';

        return 'Candidate scored ' + scoreResult.fit_score + '/100. ' +
               'Skills match: ' + (matchedSkills || 'N/A') + '. ' +
               'Missing: ' + (missingSkills || 'None') + '. ' +
               'Factor scores — Skills: ' + scoreResult.skills_score +
               ', Experience: ' + scoreResult.experience_score +
               ', Projects: ' + scoreResult.projects_score +
               ', Certifications: ' + scoreResult.certifications_score +
               ', Education: ' + scoreResult.education_score + '. ' +
               'Classification: ' + classification + '.';
    },

    matchSkills: function(candidateSkills, requiredSkills) {
        var candArr = (candidateSkills || '').split(',').map(function(s) {
            return s.trim().toLowerCase();
        }).filter(function(s) { return s.length > 0; });

        var reqArr = (requiredSkills || '').split(',').map(function(s) {
            return s.trim().toLowerCase();
        }).filter(function(s) { return s.length > 0; });

        var matched = [];
        var missing = [];

        for (var i = 0; i < reqArr.length; i++) {
            var found = false;
            for (var j = 0; j < candArr.length; j++) {
                if (candArr[j].indexOf(reqArr[i]) !== -1 || reqArr[i].indexOf(candArr[j]) !== -1) {
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (found) matched.push(reqArr[i]);
            else missing.push(reqArr[i]);
        }

        return {
            matched: matched,
            missing: missing,
            matchedCount: matched.length,
            totalRequired: reqArr.length
        };
    },

    type: 'AEGISResumeScorer'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>DEEPTHI</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 16:47:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>e8f16293295303107f44fb98a901a965</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AEGISResumeScorer</sys_name><sys_package display_value="AEGIS" source="x_snc_aegis">f1f4accb05d743107f44294ed7486a97</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="AEGIS">f1f4accb05d743107f44294ed7486a97</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_e8f16293295303107f44fb98a901a965</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>DEEPTHI</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 16:47:40</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
